nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Defines Fovari as a concept-stage product name with the tagline “Progress worth celebrating,” and states that requirements, UX, architecture, implementation, and deployment are not started. It lists decisions required before implementation.

layers.name: Product Concept and License
layers.description: This repository currently consists of a product concept README and GPL-3.0 license, with no implementation architecture.

tour.title: Concept Identity
tour.description: The README defines Fovari as a product name and gives the tagline “Progress worth celebrating.” It does not yet establish a primary user, use case, or product requirements.

tour.title: Current State
tour.description: The README says that user experience, technical architecture, MVP implementation, and production deployment have not started. There is no application architecture to infer from this repository.

tour.title: Product Brief First
tour.description: Before scaffolding, the README asks for the primary user, progress problem, core behavior, privacy expectations, smallest valuable MVP, and acceptance criteria. Those decisions should guide any later technical choices.

tour.title: Delivery Criteria
tour.description: The README requires a defined MVP-to-Beta-to-Production path and says the next meaningful commit should establish the product rather than generic scaffolding.

tour.title: License Decision
tour.description: The tracked LICENSE is GNU GPL-3.0. The README says to confirm that license fits the intended commercial and distribution model before introducing application code.
